nom: Origins Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers form the largest group and consistently report the mask resolving flaky, cracked, or parched patches, often within one to a few uses.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally say the mask hydrates without making them look greasy the next morning, though one reviewer noted a few tiny pimples after using it several nights in a row.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it never caused a rash or irritation despite being reaction-prone, while a notable number of other reviewers, some citing a reformulation, report redness, hives, swelling, or itching.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination oily-and-dry skin reports the mask hydrates dry patches while controlling oil, with fewer breakouts than before.
segments.mature: A few reviewers in their 40s and 50s, including one managing psoriasis and prescription retinoid use, report the mask keeps their aging skin consistently hydrated.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report dry patches, flaking, or tightness resolving within one to a few nights of use, though a couple say it did nothing for their skin or left a residue that didn't feel like real hydration.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers, some citing a reformulated version of the product, report serious reactions including redness, hives, swelling, or itching lasting more than a day, while another reviewer credits the mask with reducing long-standing redness around her nose and chin.
concerns.barrier: At least one reviewer with severely dry, flaky skin credits the mask with repairing her compromised moisture barrier after other products had failed.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, but a handful mention a few pimples or a bad breakout with white spots after use, with using it too many nights in a row cited as a possible trigger.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it hydrates without leaving them looking greasy in the morning, though a few describe the mask itself as too greasy or slow to absorb, staining pillowcases.

aspects.libelle: Thick, creamy texture that can feel sticky or tacky
Pleasant fruity scent (apricot, apple, or mango)
Scent can be very strong and lingering for some
Recent reformulation and smaller size at the same or higher price
Doubles well as a hand, foot, or body moisturizer
A little goes a long way, tube lasts a long time

extraits.texte: I put some on my face and then went to bed and when i woke up i was in red hives and my face was all swollen. it has been been like this for over 24 hours and has gotten more swollen.
Hello - this is my second time using this mask Night 1 and Night 4. My skin is puffing and I have white spots on my face. What am I doing wrong :( My face is red.
Origins overnight night mask is too greasy, leaves stains on the pillow. Very poor absorption. Wouldn't buy it again. Disappointed with the texture, but the scent is pleasant.

extraits.titre: This mask single-handedly saved my skin barrier.
extraits.texte: I was having super dry, flaky skin and NOTHING was working to fix it. On the suggestion of a friend I started using the Drink Up Intensive mask. She gave me one of the travel sized tubes of it. After 2 nights, I'd ordered 2 full-sized tubes for myself. After 2 weeks, I'd gone back in and put it on subscription. My skin isn't dry AT ALL anymore, no flakiness, and I've now been able to see results from my OTHER products and actives because my moisture barrier isn't totally shot. I cover two finger-lengths with the mask to apply--this is enough that my skin absorbs MOST of it, but there's still a thin barrier layer on top to protect from dry air at night. Using this amount every night still lets the tube last about 4-5 weeks. This stuff is life-changing.

I have a combination skin type (ie dry and oily). As of recent years, I tend to be more acne prone. I received this product as a sample when I was dabbling with ipsy.. I absolutely loved it. I'm not consistent when it comes to a skin care routine. I work twelve hours nights and I have four children. As much as I would love to get a routine down pat, there are days/nights when it becomes difficult. This is why I fell in love with this product. I would wash my face and slap this on right before I went to sleep. It didn't matter if I was able to achieve eight or more hours of sleep or a two hour power nap. When I washed it off, it carried the same results. The dry areas I had prior to applying, would feel soft and hydrated. The more oily areas didn't seem as greasy. I bought a full size bottle and I use it often. My face feels very plump and appears more bright than prior. It also helps at keeping the acne at bay. Annndddd, it smells absolutely amazing!!!

I have been a faithful to origins products for a very long time, i shied away for a short while to try other brands and products and seem to always come back. I love this mask it is a must use in my night regimen. I'm 47 and my fave needs hydration, this mask does it for me. I wake up with hydrated skin every time! The avocado ingredient has removed the redness I used to have around my nose and sometimes my chin area. Forever product on my list and the price is amazing for the result I get.
